title: Title: I created a demo of my trading app — what do you think?
author: Careful-Spirit6109
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I've created an Android presentation demo of my project, EDGE SIGNAL.

The demo lets you explore three different dashboards — LITE, MANUAL and AUTO — and see their design, navigation and features.

This is strictly a presentation demo. It doesn't include live market data, trading strategies or real trading.

I'm simply curious what you think about the interface and overall concept.

Would love to hear your honest feedback!

**EDGE Partner Demo (Android):**  
[https://edgesignal.eu/en/aplikacia](https://edgesignal.eu/en/aplikacia)

comments.author: investigatormaker
comments.body:
For EDGE SIGNAL, I'd test whether someone can explain the difference between LITE, MANUAL and AUTO before opening each dashboard. Give reviewers one task, such as finding where they'd inspect a signal, and ask which mode they'd choose and why. Keep a visible presentation-only label inside AUTO too, so the interface doesn't imply that this demo executes trades.

replies.author: Careful-Spirit6109
replies.body:
Thanks for the useful feedback! Our LITE, MANUAL and AUTO editions are designed around different levels of trader control and protection.  
Trader Protection is one of our core priorities, and the partner demo is intended for presentation only, with no trade execution.  
I agree that testing whether users clearly understand the differences between the three editions is a valuable idea. I’ll include this in our usability testing.
